scope.candidate: Fresh standalone disposable non-bare repository with detached HEAD or unborn HEAD; separate object database, index and worktree. No linked gitdir or live-project mount. Snapshot importer is trusted future work, not git worktree add or --shared clone.

origin_handling.ordinary: only captured snapshot; not original checkout
origin_handling.unborn: empty initial index; no HEAD required
origin_handling.linked: reject original origin in v1, even though SEC28 stage/commit RPC exists
origin_handling.bare: reject; SEC28 project/add rejection is not no-checkout target acceptance
origin_handling.no_checkout_target: reject ref mutation; not equivalent to bare origin

scope.publication: none: candidate tree OID and bounded status only; no host copy-back, refs or journal mutation
scope.hook_policy: Reject any installed executable hook, including unrecognized names; non-executable files are data only; executable *.sample files also reject conservatively. Reject non-default core.hooksPath. Validate captured common-dir hooks and runtime mode semantics; no host discovery fallback. Conservative whole-request rejection even for hooks irrelevant to the chosen command.
scope.helper_policy: Reject all configured filter.* drivers and any effective filter attribute, custom merge driver/config/attribute, filter-process, signing, fsmonitor, external diff/textconv, submodule commands and config-selected exec. No success with raw bytes when a filter would apply.
scope.snapshot_policy: Pin source config/includes/attributes/ignore/object metadata and contents as one reviewed input digest; uncertain capture, concurrent change or unsupported dependency yields INPUT_UNSTABLE/UNSUPPORTED_ORIGIN before candidate execution. Mutable discovery cannot be security enforcement. Stage B containment remains mandatory.

limits.status: proposed_limits_not_probed; setup failure or unsupported limits reject RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE

scope.environment: Trusted fixed Git/runtime identity and minimal environment; no caller environment, PATH, HOME, credentials or host sockets. Broker-owned GIT_INDEX_FILE and scratch only; native hooks disabled as defense in depth. GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 for InspectCandidate. No executable exceptions for child Git/helpers.
scope.failure_state: Preflight deny preserves candidate and original bytes. After execution begins, record actual candidate index/object changes and discard/quarantine candidate on failure; do not claim Git add is atomic. Original snapshot/live project is never a write target. Timeout or missing descendant termination proof is recovery_required, no success/retry.

operations.writes: no candidate writes; GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 and read-only mount; reject unsupported runtime
operations.result: bounded byte records; no user-supplied revision/options

request.paths: nonempty unique relative literal paths; reject absolute, dot-dot, NUL, metadata paths and symlink parent escapes; leading dash is literal after --

operations.writes: candidate index and object database only; helper/hook/origin preflight must complete first
operations.result: tree OID, index digest and changed paths; new snapshot digest invalidates prior requests; no commit, ref, checkpoint or live staging equivalence claim

excluded.reason: Restoration writes files and may require smudge helpers; no whole-file rollback claim.
No commit/commit-tree substitution. Root/ordinary/amend message/index edits and hook ordering require broker acceptance.
Reject all checkout and no-checkout variants. Missing prepare/reference/post phases cannot become silent success. Preserve existing GIT6 changed-tree refusal; no code change.
No rebase/cherry-pick/merge continue or abort; absent daemon hooks are a compatibility difference.
Full capture includes commit-tree/update-ref; StageCandidatePaths is not capture. Prompt, safety, retention and delete remain excluded.
No setup script, linked worktree mutation, cleanup, branch deletion or metadata prune. Existing two removal paths are distinct.
No arbitrary read interface; merge-tree writes objects and may invoke helpers. Only exact InspectCandidate status template is planned.
MCP diff/verification, clipboard exclude writes, project discovery, trailers and generic runner are not routed.
Reject required and optional filter drivers, custom merge, filter-process, signing and unsupported dependencies; never silently stage WORK instead of CLEAN.
No approved bundle runner exists in v1; reject executable hooks rather than skipping. No shell/interpreter permission exception.
Linked/bare/external gitdir/alternates/submodule originals and no-checkout publication excluded. SHA1/SHA256 candidate snapshots only.

phase_contract.disposition: all observed phases unsupported in v1; any executable installed hook blocks both requests before writes
phase_contract.fallback: pre-merge-commit sample may source git-sh-setup and invoke pre-commit. Reject executable fallback script or unresolved dependency; do not add git-sh-setup, shell or arbitrary helper exceptions. No claim of fallback parity.
phase_contract.message_index: v1 runs no hook and creates no commit; no message editing. Future broker retains changed candidate and requires new review/grant; current GIT6 refusal remains in product only.
phase_contract.reference_post: v1 never calls update-ref/commit; reference-transaction/prepared/committed/aborted and post-success phases excluded. Future publication must record completed mutation separately from late hook failure; never rerun consumed grant.

lifecycle.claim: consume submitted_prompt -> callback -> review.on_prompt (tab and enabled guards) -> legacy capture. Callback wiring inspected in bootstrap IngestHandlers(on_prompt=self._prompt_sent). No standalone capture RPC.

Review also requests session checkpoint first; only active work-session/history branch captures. WorkSessionHistory.complete uses GitCheckpoints. Not separately measured by SEC26 legacy restore cases.
Prompt keep-count overflow drops unprotected refs and journal rows; not an explicit delete RPC.

Startup/hourly sweep queues legacy deletions durably before row cascade. Drain validates absolute repo/ref shape, skips protected refs, retains failed jobs. forget_refs then updates in-memory logs and can repeat delete for known tabs; not an exactly-once Git deletion guarantee. Session refs excluded from automatic queue. No retention runtime/hook claim.

Legacy close may remove only after stop/decision and created_here guards; session close retains workspace. Worktrees.close checks lock/dirty/ahead/ignored then non-force remove followed by branch deletion. Refusal preserves worktree; no new native hook measurement.
Explicit Git cleanup service closes tabs, checks journal/state, removes via GitMutations then may delete owned branch. Distinct from Worktrees.close; not covered by SEC26 worktree-create cases.
Failed create/setup paths may force-remove disposable tree and branch. create_detached also has rollback; not normal close semantics.

No production Worktrees.prune call found by current src AST attribute-call scan; only low-level method plus tests/core/test_worktrees.py calls. This bounded syntactic negative is not proof against reflection or runtime injection.

decisions.semantics: All external helper requirements reject before writes; no raw-content fallback. Runtime denial is still required against late injection.
No hook phase supported; all installed executable hooks reject; all commit/merge/sequencer/worktree/ref mutation operations excluded. No native transparency claim.
Only two typed candidate requests and three argv templates; no general runner, original repository mounts, live writes or publication.
Keep product ref-squash changed-index refusal. Future changed candidate retained/reviewed; no claim current temporary index survives.
Publication and late post failure recorded separately, consumed hook never rerun automatically. v1 excludes both.
No live worktree/ref publication; C/D one-shot grants and crash/cancel reconciliation remain mandatory.

UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION.required_detail: typed operation/variant; no arbitrary command fallback

UNSUPPORTED_HELPER.required_detail: driver/filter/attribute and input manifest digest; no filtered-success claim

UNSUPPORTED_HOOK.required_detail: installed phase/path and bundle digest if captured; bounded escaped text only

UNSUPPORTED_ORIGIN.required_detail: unsupported gitdir/origin/dependency without host path dereference

INPUT_UNSTABLE.required_detail: expected and observed snapshot identity; no mutation

EXECUTION_FAILED.required_detail: bounded exit/stderr, actual candidate changes; never blanket unchanged-state claim after process started

CANCELLED.required_detail: descendant termination and candidate disposition; ambiguous termination becomes recovery_required

cases: SHA1/SHA256 detached and unborn standalone snapshots: native versus future worker status bytes, stage add/modify/delete with literal unusual/leading-dash paths, tree/index/file hashes, untracked and ignored preservation. Do not reuse old RPC PASS as worker acceptance.

SEC20/27 native required clean/smudge success/refusal and custom merge driver positive controls remain real; worker must reject helper fixtures with UNSUPPORTED_HELPER and unchanged input/candidate preflight state, never WORK-as-CLEAN.
Optional/process/unused driver/config/include/attribute cases reject conservatively; discovery uncertainty cannot be treated as no helper.

Executable hook for each of the eleven observed phases, unknown hook name, core.hooksPath and executable pre-merge fallback sample: reject UNSUPPORTED_HOOK before candidate writes; retain native phase positive controls.

Non-executable hook/sample controls and executable *.sample rejection controls, hook mode/path/dependency changes during capture, post-index-change on status/add/write-tree; no hook marker from worker.

Reject paths outside snapshot, NUL/metadata/symlink escapes, stale digest, unknown fields/options/environment/executable path, unsupported origin and alternates/submodules; original refs/index/files/ignored/untracked unchanged.

Every excluded operation including prompt/retention, both removal paths, rollback/prune, no-checkout merge/FF, sequencer continue/abort, root/amend/signing has a typed deny case; no fallback to current runner or direct _run_hook.

Installed immutable runtime required in a separate node after reviewed gate; original SEC11 race and SEC13 replace/include/worktree/inplace probes unchanged with positive controls; exec/FD/ABI/descendants, canaries/socket/network denial, streaming/resource/cancel limits. Preflight config listing is not enforcement.

GIT6 changed candidate refuses before ref update with staged/unstaged/untracked/ignored preservation; future retained bundle/tree/message changes require new review/grant; no arbitrary side-effect rollback assertion.

Authenticated immutable bundles and one-shot persisted grants; crashes/cancel/late post failures/old-OID CAS/restart and concurrent live writes; coordinated routing only after independent installed acceptance and related core/UI/contracts. Graceful restart is insufficient.

next_action: Separate bounded candidate compatibility fixture node for T-positive/T-helper/T-hooks/T-input/T-deny. No installed runtime, host permission change, broker or production routing; Stage A remains incomplete. Any scope expansion requires a new explicit contract and named gate.
